config.multiple_signal_rule: Earliest qualifying signal wins; ignore new signals until cooldown expires and the pending next-open entry has either fired or been skipped.
config.cash_rule: Each strategy receives the same initial funded reserve, released as equal daily contributions at 09:00 UTC. Daily DCA spends the same-day tranche immediately; weekly DCA spends the accrued reserve every Monday 09:00 UTC; drawdown buys spend the entire currently accrued reserve on a qualifying signal.
